# Little Gestures: Couples Care

> Little Gestures is a love language reminder app for couples on iPhone and Apple Watch. Set nudges for your partner, track anniversaries and check in daily.

## App

- [Love Language Reminder App | Little Gestures: Couples Care](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bond/index.html.md): Little Gestures is a love language reminder app for couples on iPhone and Apple Watch. Set nudges for your partner, track anniversaries and check in daily.

## Guides

- [The 5 Love Languages With Everyday Examples](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bond/5-love-languages-examples.html.md): The five love languages from Gary Chapman's model, each with small everyday gestures you can do in under a minute, plus what research says about them.
- [Best Love Language App for Couples: 5 Compared 2026](https://jackwallner.com/ios/bond/best-love-language-app.html.md): Five love language and couples apps compared for iPhone: quiz, reminders, daily questions, account needs and price model, with ratings as of October 2026.
